_comment: p03-remediation-priority-rules.json — Halden Distribution Ltd. (fictional, isolated home lab). What: the rules scripts/04-New-FindingsRegister.py uses to turn a Likelihood x Impact risk score into a remediation priority and a target date. Where: applies to the P3 findings register only. Status: designed values; no finding has been scored yet because the assessment has not run (AGENTS.md rule R2). Gate: no finding is actioned until scripts/00-Test-AssessmentGate.ps1 confirms the owner's authorisation.

likelihood_scale.3: possible for a motivated attacker with network access
likelihood_scale.4: likely once any single user or workstation is compromised
likelihood_scale.5: trivial and already reachable by a standard domain user

impact_scale.2: limited to one team or workstation
impact_scale.3: one service disrupted for a day
impact_scale.4: a whole department or one Tier 1 server
impact_scale.5: domain-wide: every account, workstation and server at risk

category_escalation._comment: A finding that hands an attacker direct control of the domain is escalated one band, but never above P0. This mirrors the plan's rule that paths to Domain Admin are dealt with first.
